_PAGE_FILTER_NUMBER_COMPACT_DESCRIPTION_: The function filterNumberCompact shortens a large number with a unit (thousand, million, billion, trillion), e.g. for counters, badges and dashboards. The number is formatted like filterFloat.
_PAGE_FILTER_NUMBER_COMPACT_ARGUMENTS_DI: The number of decimal places of a shortened number
_PAGE_FILTER_NUMBER_COMPACT_ARGUMENTS_MI: Numbers below this value (by amount) are not shortened
